review_type: Independent adversarial source, parity, and concurrency review of parameter import hardening, BOM decoding, missing-param feedback, and test stability
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 5.0/10). Substantial adversarial progress verified: all 15 reference parameter exclusions are enforced centrally; strict invariant numeric parsing produces source-compatible FormatException errors; StreamReader-style multi-encoding BOM decoding is active; missing-parameter feedback now triggers the canonical 'No matching Params' dialog; and the swarm sequence cancellation test regression was resolved, yielding a 100% clean 198-test local workspace and all-green remote CI tests. However, offline parameter editing without active vehicle connection is not implemented, 'Write Params' lacks the parameter change review/confirmation dialog and _ENABLE trailing sort order, and mobile document provider parity remains incomplete.

scores.scale: Adversarial parity evaluation on a 0-10 exact-clone scale. 10/10 requires 100% feature, UI/UX, behavioral, and architectural equivalence to Mission Planner C# across all target platforms.

verified_improvements: R38-01 resolved: all 15 reference excluded parameters (SYSID_SW_MREV, WP_TOTAL, CMD_TOTAL, FENCE_TOTAL, SYS_NUM_RESETS, ARSPD_OFFSET, GND_ABS_PRESS, GND_TEMP, BARO1_GND_PRESS, BARO2_GND_PRESS, BARO3_GND_PRESS, BARO_GND_TEMP, CMD_INDEX, LOG_LASTFILE, FORMAT_VERSION) are excluded centrally during load() and read().

R38-02 resolved: numbers are parsed with strict invariant f64 parsing; invalid numbers abort loading with LoadError::InvalidNumber identifying parameter name, token, and line number; multi-encoding BOM decoding (UTF-8, UTF-16 LE/BE, UTF-32 LE/BE) functions identically to .NET StreamReader.

R38-03 resolved: file_ui collects imported parameters missing from the vehicle and displays the modal 'No matching Params' window with 'Missing N params' and space-delimited list matching ConfigRawParams.cs.
R38-04 resolved: swarm background image selection test properly primes the modal layer over 3 frames, ensuring clean Escape handling without race conditions.
Full workspace test hygiene: the entire test suite passes 100% clean locally (198 tests) and in remote multi-platform CI.

evidence: In C# Mission Planner ConfigRawParams.cs (BUT_load_Click), when disconnected (BaseStream == null || !IsOpen), offline=true is passed to loadparamsfromfile, adding missing parameters directly to the parameter collection and calling Activate(). Users can inspect, modify, and save parameter files offline.
In Rust ParamEditor::ui, when app.link is None, the view displays 'Please Connect First' and returns early, precluding offline parameter inspection, file loading, modification, or saving.
findings.impact: Users preparing parameter configurations before field deployment cannot load, compare, or edit parameter files without connecting to an active autopilot.
findings.required_fix: Support offline parameter editing in ParamEditor when app.link is None: allow Load from file, Save to file, and Compare Params using an offline parameter map.

evidence: In C# ConfigRawParams.cs (BUT_writePIDS_Click lines 259-320), writing parameters sorts _ENABLE parameters to the end (temp.SortENABLE()) so features are fully configured before being enabled.

When 20 or fewer parameters are modified, ConfigRawParams displays a modal confirmation dialog: 'You are about to change N parameters. Please review the changes below:

<param>: <old> -> <new>

Do you want to proceed?' with Yes/No buttons.
In Rust ParamEditor::ui, clicking 'Write Params' immediately sends SetParam commands across the link for all staged edits without confirmation and in arbitrary BTreeMap key order.
findings.impact: Unintentional parameter writes occur without user confirmation or inspection of before/after deltas. Enabling features before configuring their sub-parameters can lead to dangerous vehicle misconfigurations.
findings.required_fix: Add a confirmation dialog showing parameter before/after values prior to transmission, and sort _ENABLE parameters to the end of the write sequence.

evidence: Mobile selection continues to browse app-local sandboxed directories.
Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) and iOS UIDocumentPickerViewController integrations remain unimplemented for parameter, mission, and log files.
findings.impact: Mobile users cannot open parameter or mission files stored in external storage, cloud drives, or downloads folders.
findings.required_fix: Implement platform-native document pickers for Android and iOS in platform.rs.

evidence: Mission Planner DataGridView provides rich visual indicators: yellow highlight for modified values, red for failed writes, green for confirmed writes, tooltips with metadata/range definitions, and context menus for 'Set to default' and 'Revert'.
The current Rust implementation provides functional text edits and modified-only filtering, but lacks visual status styling and parameter metadata tooltips.
findings.impact: Operator experience does not match the visual and interactive fidelity of Mission Planner's Raw Params screen.
findings.required_fix: Enhance ParamEditor grid with visual status highlights (modified, pending, written) and parameter documentation tooltips.

next_concrete_task: Implement offline parameter file editing in ParamEditor when app.link is None, and implement the 'Write Params' confirmation dialog with _ENABLE trailing sort order matching ConfigRawParams.cs.
